from pathlib import Path
import sys,json,hashlib,time,resource,signal,ast
import sympy as s
from sympy.polys.matrices import DomainMatrix
sys.path.insert(0,'code')
from classification_rank3_mixed_component_review import COLUMNS,ROWS,jacobi,sparse,vector
begun=time.monotonic();signal.alarm(180);resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(3072*1024**2,)*2)
root=Path('.');jp='research/classification/jobs/cubic_cone_rank_two_one_normal_quadratic.json';job=json.loads((root/jp).read_text())
for r in job['exact_inputs_and_hashes']:assert hashlib.sha256((root/r['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==r['sha256'],r['path']
old=json.loads((root/'reports/CLASSIFICATION_CUBIC_CONE_RANK_TWO_ONE_ORBIT_AMBIENT_20261108.json').read_bytes())
def decode(a):return s.SparseMatrix(*a['shape'],{tuple(map(int,k.split(','))):s.Rational(v)for k,v in a['entries'].items()})
def encode(a):return {'shape':list(a.shape),'entries':{str(i)+','+str(j):str(c)for(i,j),c in a.todok().items()}}
def dm(a):return DomainMatrix.from_Matrix(a).convert_to(s.QQ)
def rrefp(a):return list(dm(a).rref()[1])
D=decode(old['complete_sparse_matrices']['full350_D']);M=decode(old['complete_sparse_matrices']['Euler_GL5_scalar51'])
cert=old['complete_rank_minor_kernel_certificates'];K=decode(cert['full350_D']['full_kernel'])
Mp=cert['Euler_GL5_scalar51']['minor_columns'];M49=M[:,Mp];assert M49.shape==(150,49)
piv=rrefp(M49.row_join(K));extra=[p-49 for p in piv if p>=49];assert len(extra)==1
R=K[:,extra[0]];R*=s.ilcm(*[a.q for a in R]);R/=s.igcd(*[abs(int(a))for a in R if a]);assert D*R==s.zeros(350,1)
cp=cert['full350_D']['minor_columns'];rp=cert['full350_D']['minor_rows'];U=s.eye(150)[:,cp]
frame=M49.row_join(R).row_join(U);assert frame.shape==(150,150)
frame_dm=dm(frame);det=frame_dm.det();assert det
inverse=frame_dm.inv().to_Matrix();assert inverse*frame==s.eye(150)and frame*inverse==s.eye(150)
cuts=inverse[:49,:];assert cuts*M49==s.eye(49)and cuts*frame[:,49:]==s.zeros(49,101)
x=s.symbols('x0:5');P=s.zeros(5);RR=s.zeros(5)
for key,v in old['all_actual_point_brackets'].items():
 i,j=ast.literal_eval(key);P[i,j]=s.sympify(v,locals={str(t):t for t in x});P[j,i]=-P[i,j]
for value,(ij,e)in zip(R,COLUMNS):
 i,j=ij;mon=s.prod(x[k]**e[k]for k in range(5));RR[i,j]+=value*mon;RR[j,i]-=value*mon
assert vector(sparse(RR,x))==R
Q=jacobi(sparse(RR,x));assert Q.shape==(350,1)
assert jacobi(sparse(P+RR,x))==Q
sub=D.extract(rp,cp);inv=dm(sub).inv().to_Matrix();assert sub*inv==s.eye(100)and inv*sub==s.eye(100)
T=-U*inv*Q[rp,:];residual=Q+D*T;assert residual[rp,:]==s.zeros(100,1)
nonzero=[i for i,a in enumerate(residual)if a];row=nonzero[0]if nonzero else None
functional=s.zeros(1,350)
if row is not None:
 functional[0,row]=1;co=D[row,cp]*inv
 for j,r in enumerate(rp):functional[0,r]-=co[j]
 assert functional*D==s.zeros(1,150)and(functional*Q)[0]==residual[row]
rank_aug=100+bool(nonzero);assert len(rrefp(D.row_join(Q)))==rank_aug
report={'task_id':'E_reduced_nonnormal','all_exact_arithmetic_passed':True,
 'same_canonical_whole24orbit_only':old['same_whole_orbit_canonical_point'],
 'source_49columns':{'original_M51_columns':Mp,'complete_matrix':encode(M49)},
 'genuine_normal':{'original_Dkernel_column':extra[0],'integer_vector':encode(R),'actual_quadratic_brackets':{str((i,j)):str(RR[i,j])for i in range(5)for j in range(i+1,5)if RR[i,j]},'D_R_zero':True},
 'U100_original_coordinate_columns':cp,'full150_directsum_frame':encode(frame),'frame_determinant':str(det),'frame_inverse':encode(inverse),'both_inverse_products_identity':True,'true49_linear_cut_rows':encode(cuts),'cut_on_source_identity_and_normal_U_zero':True,
 'full350_quadratic_Jacobi_R':encode(Q),'quadratic_U_correction':encode(T),'full350_corrected_quadratic_residual':encode(residual),'selected100_residual_rows_zero':True,
 'full_D_Q_rank':rank_aug,'quadratic_cokernel_nonzero':bool(nonzero),'cokernel_functional':encode(functional),'functional_D_all150_zero':row is not None,'nonzero_residual_row':row,'functional_Q':str((functional*Q)[0]),
 'fixed_truecut_one_variable_quadratic_initial_support_radical_origin':bool(nonzero),'orbitclosure24_fullcomponent_proved_by_this_arithmetic':False,
 'componenthood_requires_independent_IFTopenness_and_wholeorbit_bridge':True,'if_quadratic_zero_stop_no_cubic_or_jet_continuation':True,'new_component_count':0,
 'inline_source':job['inline_source'],'inline_source_sha256':job['inline_source_sha256'],'input_bindings':job['exact_inputs_and_hashes'],
 'seconds':time.monotonic()-begun,'maximum_RSS_KiB':resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss}
p=root/'reports/CLASSIFICATION_CUBIC_CONE_RANK_TWO_ONE_NORMAL_QUADRATIC_20261108.json'
with p.open('x')as f:json.dump(report,f,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2);f.write('\n')
print(json.dumps({'PASS':True,'frame_det':str(det),'rank_D_Q':rank_aug,'lambda_Q':report['functional_Q'],'normal_R_nonzero_entries':len(R.todok()),'quadratic_nonzero':bool(nonzero),'seconds':report['seconds'],'RSS':report['maximum_RSS_KiB']}),flush=True)
